title: Meta's app for creating generative AI minigames is now available in the US
content:
Meta's app for creating generative AI minigames is now available in the US
It's called Pocket and is described as a "platform for making and sharing gizmos."
Meta's little vibe-coding app Pocket has now arrived in the US after a brief testing phase in Brazil. The app lets people generate minigames, called gizmos, via prompts. The games get published to a scrollable feed, bringing in a social media component. Users can save gizmos to a favorites list and repost gizmos to their feed.
These games make full use of the capabilities available in modern smartphones. They can respond to both touch and tilt and can include photos and even songs. Once saved to a profile, other people can remix them into unique creations.
They are called gizmos instead of minigames for a couple of probable reasons. First of all, they aren't just games. The marketing advertises simple experiences like a canvas to paint on. Also, Meta hired nearly the entire team behind an app called, well, Gizmo. This led to the app shutting down. Gizmo was basically the same thing as Pocket and even used similar nomenclature (referring to the creations as gizmos).
In any event, Pocket is available right now and it's free. It could be worth a download and a couple of minutes before getting bored.
This is just the latest AI-forward move that Meta has made. Last year, the company launched a feature for the Meta AI app called Vibes that's basically a feed for AI slop. Facebook also recently introduced the ability to tweak profile photos with AI-powered animations.

report.summary: Meta 的生成式 AI 小游戏应用 Pocket 在美国上线，可创建并分享迷你游戏。
report.background: Meta 在巴西测试 Pocket 后将其推向美国。这款应用允许用户通过提示词生成迷你游戏（称为 gizmos），并支持社交分享和二次创作。此前 Meta 已推出 AI 信息流 Vibes 和 AI 头像动画等功能，持续加码 AI 消费端应用。Pocket 的团队与已关闭的 Gizmo 应用高度相关，概念几乎一致。
key_points: Pocket 是一款 AI 生成小游戏平台，用户输入提示词即可创建游戏并发布到信息流。
游戏支持触摸、倾斜、照片和音乐，体现现代手机功能，还能被他人重混。
称之为 gizmos 是为了涵盖游戏之外的艺术画布等体验，且团队来自已关闭的 Gizmo 应用。
Pocket 目前免费，在美国可用，是 Meta 继 Vibes 后又一 AI 社交化尝试。
report.impact: 对 AI 行业而言，这降低了游戏开发门槛，推动生成式 AI 进入休闲娱乐领域。对开发者，可快速制作原型并借鉴社交传播模式。对普通用户，无需编程即可创作和分享互动内容，但 AI 生成质量可能参差不齐，容易产生低质量内容刷屏现象。
report.tools: 可关注 Meta 的 AI 开发框架 Llama、生成式 AI 工具 Meta AI，以及类似的开源项目如 Hugging Face 的 gradio 或 streamlit，用于快速搭建交互式 AI 应用。
